articles.title: Medtronic invests $700M in surgical partner Cornerstone Robotics
articles.excerpt: Medtronic and Cornerstone Robotics are building a multi-port portfolio anchored by the Hugo surgical system and expanded by Sentire. The post Medtronic invests $700M in surgical partner Cornerstone Robotics appeared first on The Robot Report.

articles.title: JAKA hits Teradyne Robotics back over patent dispute
articles.excerpt: JAKA is now taking legal action against Teradyne Robotics to end public dissemination of statements it considers "false, misleading and damaging." The post JAKA hits Teradyne Robotics back over patent dispute appeared first on The Robot Report.
